thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: kv_cache_reuse_error group firing for prod-us-west-2. Elevated 5xxs + increased P95 token latency. Paging @mira (oncall)

mira (oncall): I'm on it — seeing a sharp spike at ~14:07 UTC. Error log shows 'kv_lookup returned seq_mismatch' repeatedly.

anya (eng-sre): metrics: error_rate rose from 0.02% -> 1.3% in 3m. Affected pool: inference-pool-9. Dashboard: large batched jobs correlate with errors.

oj (eng-runtime): quick dump from runtime: multiple cache entries have identical keys but differing seq_offset metadata. Looks like cache entries being re-used before fully initialized for new requests under continuous batching.

mira (oncall): immediate mitigation: pause continuous batching for pool inference-pool-9 and trigger per-worker cache clear. Will request deploy.

deploy-bot: Deploy request created by mira: PATCH /config/pools/inference-pool-9 - {"continuous_batching_enabled": false} 
deploy-bot: Rollout started to pool nodes (8 nodes).

ops-bot: Running kvcache flush on nodes with highest error counts. Command issued to fleet manager.

jun (customer-sre): Opening customer comms: discovered 4 customers reporting failures (BeaconAI, LexaSearch, MapFlow, ByteDocs). Notifying account teams and creating incident tickets.

mira (oncall): after toggling batching, 5xxs fell by ~85% within 2 minutes. Still seeing sporadic seq_mismatch traces on 2 nodes.

oj (eng-runtime): prepping hotfix to check request_id/tag on KV get path and drop entries that don't match. Also adding metric kv_mismatch_dropped_count. Small runtime patch, PR ready.

deploy-bot: Hotfix PR merged, canary rollout to 2 nodes started.

ops-bot: Canary nodes report no seq_mismatch and stable latencies for 7m.

anya (eng-sre): note on tradeoffs: disabling batching increases per-token CPU and network pressure. We'll track client latency and token spend.

mira (oncall): initiating account outreach: Jun, please include: brief of issue, mitigations taken, scope (# requests impacted, window), ETA for full re-enable.

jun (customer-sre): drafting now. Current estimate: ~0.45% of regional requests impacted during 14:07-14:25 UTC window. Sending to account leads in next 10m.

sam (night-oncall): I'll take watch for the next 4 hours. Main actions: 1) monitor kv_mismatch_dropped_count and kv_error_rate; 2) ensure hotfix remains stable; 3) coordinate with runtime for tests before re-enable.

mira (oncall): Sam, confirm alert policy: if error_rate > 0.5% for > 5m, page eng-runtime and eng-sre.

sam (night-oncall): confirmed.

oj (eng-runtime): post-fix followup items: 1) fix race in KV allocator to avoid slot reuse until entry init completes; 2) add latency-safe strict-namespace option; 3) add fuzz tests for overlapping batch windows; 4) add a canary config to enable continuous batching only after self-checks pass. Filing INF-3620 with details.

anya (eng-sre): I'm recording timeline for postmortem:
- 14:07 UTC: Alert fired (kv_cache_reuse_error)
- 14:09 UTC: Continuous batching disabled for inference-pool-9 (partial mitigation)
- 14:11 UTC: kvcache flush on affected nodes
- 14:18 UTC: Runtime hotfix canary deployed -> green
- 14:26 UTC: Hotfix rolled to remaining nodes; continuous batching remains disabled pending validation

mira (oncall): customer impact summary for notes: small fraction of requests returned stale tokens/offsets due to KV entries returning wrong seq_offset. No evidence of data exfil or persisted PII leakage. Primary risk: incorrect model outputs and failures; affected customers notified.

jun (customer-sre): customers updated. Created follow-up support threads and offered exec briefings where requested.

mira (oncall): handoff to sam (night-oncall). Sam, checklist: 1) verify kv_mismatch_dropped_count stays near zero; 2) ensure no new 5xx spikes; 3) coordinate with runtime to run the overlapping-batches fuzz tests in prod-sim; 4) prepare timeline for re-enable (do not re-enable until runtime gives green).

sam (night-oncall): ack. I'll keep a 2-hour watch and escalate if metrics deviate.

oj (eng-runtime): adding runtime note: continuous batching previously optimized for throughput by recycling internal buffer slots quickly; under bursty request arrival these slots could be reassigned before metadata (seq_offset, request_id) was fully written. Fix ensures slot is marked 'initializing' and not readable until complete.

anya (eng-sre): temporary config change: continuous_batching_enabled=false on inference-pool-9. kvcache flush executed at 14:11 UTC. runtime hotfix deployed 14:18-14:26 UTC.

mira (oncall): labels: sev-2, kv-cache, continuous-batching, seq-mismatch, hotfix. Creating incident doc and assigning to postmortem owner.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and assigned to Mira.

sam (night-oncall): one operational suggestion: add realtime 'kv_owner' tags in traces so we can immediately map stale returns to the worker or batch window. Filing ticket.

oj (eng-runtime): will add kv_owner + request_tag metadata to traces and increase sampling for 24h. Also will run benchmarks to quantify perf impact of strict isolation.

mira (oncall): thanks all. closing active coordination. leaving channel for sam to monitor and re-open for postmortem draft. :thumbsup:
